newsitem.title: BENIN: Yellow fever and cholera kill 200 in Benin.
newsitem.headline: Yellow fever and cholera kill 200 in Benin.

text.p: Yellow fever and cholera killed 208 people in the West African state of Benin in July, August and September, the health ministry said.
Cases of cholera, which killed 146 people, were scattered throughout the country while yellow fever, which killed 62 people, was mainly in the north, ministry officials said on Wednesday.

The ministry said the outbreaks had been brought under control thanks to vaccination campaigns and the strengthening of medical teams working in the field. Several aid partners donated medicine and vaccine.
